586:t_1:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Big Sis, I thought I'd finally gotten to see you again, and then something like that suddenly happened. I was so shocked!」

586:t_1:5.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Truly the mystery of the cosmos... And going beyond it, we met again.」

586:t_1:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「So you're $$ノノ$$. I've heard most of the story from $$ノリコ$$.」

586:t_1:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$. I'm the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

586:t_1:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Another one who rides a $$バスターマシン$$... or rather, you are the $$バスターマシン$$ itself. Will you get along with me?」

586:t_1:12.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's work well together from now on. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

586:t_1:14.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you planning to swap out your Big Sis?」

586:t_1:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$! $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis is, now and for all eternity...」

586:t_1:17.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened with the Princess, but hurry up and make up with her, okay?」

586:t_1:18.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the Queen of Roses telling us that the $$バスターマシン$$ pilots on this side have no fighting spirit.」

586:t_1:20.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'll be expecting great things from you, $$ノノ$$.」

586:t_1:21.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's all right, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the next best duo after you and me.」

586:t_1:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I never thought $c would be teleported by one person's wish...」

586:t_1:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「I think it is less that I was a special existence than that my feelings were picked up in a nearly random way.」

586:t_1:25.en:
$$桂$$
「I felt how utterly absurd the situation was back then, too.」

586:t_1:26.en:
$$桂$$
「The sensation of so many people's feelings swirling together was similar to the $$時空修復|lc$$ during the $$多元戦争$$, but the sheer chaos of it was on another level.」

586:t_1:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So it was a special situation back then...」

586:t_1:28.en:
$$万丈$$
「The warping of the dimensional boundary line seems to have calmed for now, but there's no telling when something will happen again.」

586:t_1:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we're careless, $$バアル$$'s full-scale invasion could begin through that hole...」

586:t_1:30.en:
$$オルソン$$
「There's also a chance spacetime itself collapses before that.」

586:t_1:31.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Three keys... It seems the third $$特異点$$ was not Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$ after all.」

586:t_1:32.en:
$$オルソン$$
「She was a $$特異点$$ of the $$ウィスパード$$ phenomenon, but now that her ability is gone, we should assume the key the $$サイデリアル$$ speak of lies elsewhere.」

586:t_1:34.en:
$$桂$$
(Thanks to $$レナード$$ treating me as an enemy, I've started to see who that third one is...)

586:t_1:38.en:
$$桂$$
(If it's that person, I have to be careful. Having been in that group, they have to be seriously twisted...)

586:t_1:39.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The search for the three keys... So we're back to square one.」

586:t_1:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「Then the quickest way would be to ask the source of that information directly.」

586:t_1:42.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Because we came to the $$蒼の地球$$, each of the three Reactors made a move. As a result, the fronts in various regions have gradually thinned out.」

586:t_1:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「In the meantime, the preparations for a counteroffensive must have advanced too.」

586:t_1:44.en:
$$桂$$
「All that's left is judging when to give the GO, huh.」

586:t_1:45.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That black $$アンゲロイ$$ might show up there too...」

586:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It seems those guys are beings that move the histories of various worlds from behind the scenes.」

586:t_1:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'd like to make the relationship between the fundamental calamity and the $$サイデリアル$$ clear soon, too.」

586:t_1:48.en:
$$シャア$$
「But before that, we need to settle things.」

586:t_1:49.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$, huh...」

586:t_1:50.en:
$$オルソン$$
「They've lost strength too, with $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$ザフト$$ breaking away. They may come at us with a last-ditch strategy to turn things around.」

586:t_1:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The focal point of that battle will probably be the existence of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

586:t_1:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Something capable of overturning the very existence of the $$地球連邦$$...」

586:t_1:53.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If it falls into $$フル・フロンタル$$'s hands, cunning as he is... he'll use it as material to break the anti-Empire forces everywhere.」

586:t_1:54.en:
$$万丈$$
「At this point in time, that is the one thing I want to avoid.」

586:t_1:55.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't like the sound of that... That guy always goes for these realistic schemes.」

586:t_1:56.en:
$$シャア$$
「He is precisely me with the naivete taken out.」

586:t_1:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That smile... You seem to have shaken it off.」

586:t_1:58.en:
$$シャア$$
「A miracle happened, after all. If I can't turn it into strength, I'd have no face to show to everyone I've troubled.」

586:t_1:59.en:
$$桂$$
「Good, good. If our general doesn't steel himself, the young ones will get shaken too.」

586:t_1:61.en:
$$万丈$$
「With you as you are now, $c... no, I mean you might even be able to carry all of humanity on your back.」

586:t_1:63.en:
$$シャア$$
「Besides, the future of humanity is not so light that any one person could carry it.」

586:t_1:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But even so, I'll have you understand that you are in a position where you are not permitted to abandon that burden.」

586:t_1:65.en:
$$シャア$$
「So you mean I come from a line of human sacrifices?」

586:t_1:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Everyone has their own role. It's much the same as $$クロウ$$ and his friends' short-straw luck, or $n and his friends' volunteer spirit.」

586:t_1:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「...There is a wall we must overcome before that.」

586:t_1:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The final phase of $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$...」

586:t_1:69.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And before that, the showdown with $$フル・フロンタル$$, who will surely make his move first.」

586:t_1:70.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To meet that head-on, I hear $c will finish resupplying aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

586:t_1:71.en:
$$シャア$$
「So that is where the decisive battle with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will be fought...」

586:t_1:72.en:
$$桂$$
「So the fight over $$ラプラスの箱$$ that started with the $$時獄戦役$$ is finally reaching its climax.」

586:t_1:73.en:
$$万丈$$
「It may be improper of me, but having come this far, I can't help wondering what is inside the box.」

586:t_1:74.en:
$$シャア$$
「Let's leave its disclosure to the judgment of those who were entrusted with the box.」

586:t_1:75.en:
$$桂$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Her Highness $$ミネバ$$, huh.」

586:t_1:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to believe those two will use that power to carry on toward the future...」

586:t_1:80.en: ～ $$ネオ・ジオン$$ Leader's Private Room ～

586:t_1:81.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「...Does the fact that you told me the truth mean you acknowledge me as humanity's successor?」

586:t_1:82.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That depends on you from here on.」

586:t_1:83.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Understood. Then I will show you that I can seal the box by my own power.」

586:t_1:84.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「In order to save humanity from despair.」

586:t_1:85.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be looking forward to it.」
